meta.name: analyzing-cloud-storage-access-patterns
meta.description: Detect abnormal access patterns in AWS S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage by analyzing CloudTrail Data Events, GCS audit logs, and Azure Storage Analytics. Identifies after-hours bulk downloads, access from new IP addresses, unusual API calls (GetObject spikes), and potential data exfiltration using statistical baselines and time-series anomaly detection.

copy.tagline: 检测云存储中的异常访问和数据泄露行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责云存储安全，需要自动发现可疑访问模式。
copy.tagline_en: Detect abnormal access and data exfiltration in cloud storage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cloud storage security and need to automatically identify suspicious access patterns.

howto.what: 分析AWS S3、GCS、Azure Blob Storage的访问日志，自动检测异常模式，如下班后大量下载、新IP访问、API调用激增等，并生成报告。
howto.when: 当你提供云存储访问日志或要求检测安全威胁时触发，常用于安全事件调查或构建检测规则。

say.text: 帮我分析过去24小时S3的GetObject事件，找出异常下载。
say.note: 它会检查批量下载和新IP。

say.text: 检查今天有没有不常见的ListBucket调用。
对比上周和本周的访问基线，报告异常IP。

howto.what_en: Analyzes access logs from AWS S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage to automatically detect abnormal patterns such as after-hours bulk downloads, new IP addresses, API call spikes, and potential data exfiltration, then generates findings reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide cloud storage access logs or request security threat detection, commonly used during incident investigations or building detection rules.

say_en.text: Analyze S3 GetObject events from the last 24h for unusual downloads.
say_en.note: It checks for bulk downloads and new IPs.

say_en.text: Check for uncommon ListBucket calls today.
Compare access baselines from last week to this week and report anomalous IPs.
